details.completeness_justification: All HIGH importance criteria (K1, K2, K4, K5, K6, K8) are fully present. K3 (MEDIUM) is also present. K7 (MEDIUM) is present. Only K9 (HIGH) is missing, as there is no explicit mention of Group EBITDA figures. details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradiction: revenue growth is supported by segment details, profit improvements are explained by margin expansion and reduced finance costs, and cash flow changes are logically connected to operational performance and capital allocation decisions. The structure follows a clear narrative arc from revenue performance through profitability metrics to cash flow and balance sheet impacts. No material contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational problems are present. While some numerical relationships (e.g., segment vs consolidated figures) aren't explicitly reconciled, the candidate does not claim these are directly additive, so this does not constitute an internal contradiction under the evaluation criteria.
